methodological_limitations.title: Methodological Limitations
default: Fixed-horizon snapshot inference; repeated peeking does not preserve nominal error rates.
User-level independence is assumed; shared-account dependence is not adjusted.
One primary metric per experiment; no joint correction across experiments.
